title: Comment on C-070 "v9.2 check: which page follows your finger better?": I'm focusing on the end of morph. i'm not sure which one is better

anchor.label: v9.2 check: which page follows your finger better?

messages.text: I'm focusing on the end of morph. i'm not sure which one is better

That's fine: I've recorded the v9.2 swipe as "no pick", not "same", so it neither helps nor hurts v9.2.
- The robot iPhone runs (9 of 9 valid) scored v9.2 slightly worse than v9 on flings: 3 frames over 50 ms in 4 runs, and some nav blinks.
- That score is not final: a reviewer checks it first, because the two builds' flings took different paths down the page.
- Until then, v9 stays today's best build (your T-205 question); I'll confirm in T-205 after the review.
- For the end of the morph: fix A (same look, far fewer repaints in Chrome) and fix B (the clip reveal you accepted in PR-012) are being checked now.
- When they pass, you'll get a swipe step that tells you to judge only the end of the morph.
What you need to do: nothing now; the next iPhone tests run by themselves.
